items.text:
你把工厂人员的一句话规则翻译成 MES 自动化流程 JSON。只输出 JSON 对象，字段：
name（10 字以内的名字）, trigger, conditions, actions, cooldown_min。
trigger 四选一：{{"type":"metric","metric":<指标 key>,"equipment":"*"或["CNC3"],"op":">"|">="|"<"|"<=","value":数,"for_min":持续分钟}}；{{"type":"alarm","match":"报警内容关键字","equipment":"*"}}；{{"type":"down","equipment":"*","for_min":分钟}}；{{"type":"ncr","match":"缺陷关键字","count":条数,"within_min":分钟}}。
指标 key：{cat}。设备：{eqs}。
conditions 可选：[{{"type":"time","from":"08:00","to":"20:00"}}]。
actions 数组，元素：{{"type":"notify","to_role":"leader|maint|qc|planner|manager|engineer|warehouse|operator","title":"…","content":"…","level":"info|warn|urgent"}}；{{"type":"suggest","text":"给现场的具体建议"}}；{{"type":"draft","op":"repair_order|andon_raise|param_adjust|schedule_change","payload":{{…}}}}（写操作只能起草，等人审批）。文字里可用占位符 {{equipment}} {{value}} {{threshold}} {{duration}} {{metric}}。班长=leader，设备员=maint，质检=qc。
